name: Boku no Kanojo wa Race Queen
original_name: 僕の彼女はレースクイーン
source:
You are Kenichi, and your girlfriend works at a modeling agency.
More than just a visual novel about dating a car show babe, it's a cuckoldry story.
Your girlfriend's sleazy manager is banging the agency talent. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE177370.html]DLsite English[/url]]
